# Rowboat, 2.2 m: a hull (a box whose keel edge is squeezed, bow pointed), its top a dark inside, a light thwart.
# It bobs: rolls +-7 deg and heaves 6 cm, a 3 s loop from frame 0, eased (a bob, not a spin). Up Z.
new
fps 24
frame range 0 72
add mesh cube --name Hull --size 1 --location 0 0 0.15
scale 2.2 0.9 0.5
apply --scale
material new Hull --base-color 0.941 0.965 0.941
active Hull
mode edit
select vert where "pos.z < 0"
scale 0.8 0.35 1
select vert where "pos.x > 1.0"
scale 1 0.15 1
select face where "normal.z > 0.9"
material new Inside --base-color 0.133 0.137 0.137
material assign Inside
mode object
add mesh cube --name Thwart --size 1 --location 0 0 0.36
scale 0.25 0.85 0.08
apply --scale
material assign Hull
select Hull Thwart
active Hull
join
rename Hull Boat
cursor set 0 0 0
origin set --to cursor
shade flat
select Boat
set rotation -7 0 0
set location 0 0 0
keyframe insert --channels loc,rot --frame 0
set rotation 7 0 0
set location 0 0 -0.06
keyframe insert --channels loc,rot --frame 36
set rotation -7 0 0
set location 0 0 0
keyframe insert --channels loc,rot --frame 72
frame set 0
export boat.glb --bake-animations
